workspace.title: Teaching profile
workspace.subtitle: Complete your profile, availability, and verification details so families can be matched with you.
workspace.helpBody: Our support team can help with anything you can't complete here yet, including adding a new subject.

completion.gatingNote: Complete the required steps before your profile can be matched with students.
completion.allSet: Your profile is complete. New steps will appear here if anything changes.

profile.title: Teaching profile
profile.description: Tell families who you are and how you teach.
profile.headline: Professional headline
profile.headlinePlaceholder: e.g. Mathematics tutor specializing in Algebra and Precalculus
profile.bioHelper: Tell families about your teaching experience, approach, and the students you work best with.
profile.educationHelper: A short summary of your degrees or qualifications.
profile.saveError: We could not save your changes. Your entries are still here. Try again.

capabilities.subjectsDescription: The subjects you teach, and the grade levels you're qualified for.
capabilities.lockedBody: Subjects, grade levels, and languages become editable once your teaching profile exists.
capabilities.noSubjectsBody: Your teaching subjects are set up by the 2tor team when you join. Contact support if a subject is missing or incorrect.
capabilities.addSubjectHint: Adding a new subject isn't available here yet — contact support to add one.
capabilities.levelsDescription: Choose the grade levels and courses you are qualified to teach.
capabilities.preservedRanges: {count, plural, one {# additional grade range is} other {# additional grade ranges are}} on file but can't be shown here. Contact support to review them.
capabilities.languagesDescription: Choose the languages you can confidently use during lessons.
capabilities.noLanguagesBody: Add at least one language so families know what to expect during lessons.
capabilities.needsBoth: At least one subject and one language are required.
capabilities.saveError: We could not save your changes. Your entries are still here. Try again.

availability.title: Weekly availability
availability.description: Set the times when students can request lessons.
availability.lockedBody: Weekly availability becomes editable once your teaching profile exists.
availability.emptyBody: Add at least one weekly time range so students can request lessons.
availability.fixInvalidRanges: Fix the highlighted time range before saving.
availability.saveError: We could not save your changes. Your entries are still here. Try again.

documents.title: Verification documents
documents.description: Upload the documents required to verify your identity and qualifications.
documents.lockedBody: Document upload becomes available once your teaching profile exists.
documents.dropzoneLabel: Drag a file here, or click to browse
documents.formatsHint: PDF, JPG, or PNG · up to 10 MB
documents.uploadError: We could not upload this file. Try again.
documents.invalidType: That file type isn't supported. Use PDF, JPG, or PNG.
documents.tooLarge: That file is larger than 10 MB.

verification.title: Verification status
verification.description: Track your identity and qualification checks.
verification.emptyBody: Upload your verification documents to begin the review process.

training.title: Evaluations and training
training.description: Track the evaluations and training assigned to you.
training.emptyBody: Evaluations and training assigned to you by the 2tor team will appear here.

preview.title: Family profile preview
preview.noHeadline: Add a headline to introduce yourself to families.
preview.noDetails: Add subjects, languages, and grade levels to complete your preview.
preview.notPublishable: Your profile will become visible after verification.

students.title: Students
students.subtitle: The students matched to you, active and past.
students.noActiveBody: Once you're matched with a family, they'll appear here.
students.feedbackCount: {count, plural, one {# feedback note} other {# feedback notes}}
students.emptyTitle: You do not have assigned students yet.
students.emptyBody: Complete your profile and availability so we can match you with suitable learners.
